workarounds.symptom: Workflow automatic retries ignore the node deadline
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(workflows): enforce node deadlines on automatic retries. Target files: scripts/e2e/scenarios/workflow-retry-deadline.ts, src/workflows/engine.ts, src/workflows/foreach-driver.ts. **Why:** Enforce the configured node deadline on automatic retries so an over-budget attempt cannot complete the workflow successfully. . (Ref: https://github.com/desplega-ai/agent-swarm/pull/3349)

workarounds.symptom: An event subscriber that rejects a payload prevents later workflows from starting
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(workflows): isolate event subscriber startup failures. Target files: scripts/e2e/scenarios/workflow-event-subscriber-isolation.ts, src/workflows/triggers.ts, scripts/e2e/coverage-manifest.json. **Why:** Keep delivering workflow events when a subscriber fails to start. . (Ref: https://github.com/desplega-ai/agent-swarm/pull/3365)

workarounds.symptom: Dashboard: crypto.randomUUID is not a function on non-HTTPS self-hosted origins
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(ui): support UUID generation on HTTP origins. Target files: apps/ui/src/api/hooks/use-fleet-report.test.ts, apps/ui/src/api/hooks/use-fleet-report.ts, apps/ui/src/api/hooks/use-notification-events.ts. **Why:** Self-hosted HTTP dashboards can submit fleet report subscriptions and other UUID-backed actions when the browser does not expose `crypto.randomUUID`. . (Ref: https://github.com/desplega-ai/agent-swarm/pull/3031)
